title: Why the 1993 Atari Jaguar Was Marketed as ‘The 64‑Bit Monster’

scenes.text: 1993 Atari called the Jaguar a 64‑bit monster – was it true?
Its GPU processed 32‑bit data but used a 64‑bit data bus internally.
scenes.label: 64‑BIT DATA BUS

scenes.text: The system combined three custom chips, making programming extremely complex.
scenes.label: TRIPLE‑CHIP DESIGN

scenes.text: Limited third‑party support meant few games could truly exploit the hardware.
scenes.label: SCARCE GAMES
